title: Moong Dal Chilla
description: Thin, protein rich pancakes made from soaked yellow moong dal ground with ginger, green chilli and cumin.
steps: Drain the soaked moong dal and grind with the green chilli, ginger, cumin seeds, turmeric powder, hing, salt and about 100 ml of water to a smooth, pourable batter.
Stir in the chopped onion and coriander leaves.
Heat a non-stick tawa over medium heat and brush with a little oil.
Pour a ladle of batter and spread it quickly into a thin round.
Drizzle a little oil around the edges and cook for 2 minutes until the underside is golden.
Flip, cook for another minute and serve hot with mint chutney or curd.
